lesson_13_prng_and_statistical_tests::se.refutation_markdown: **Refutation:** Two parallel bugs ruin supercomputer MC runs: (1) initializing all $P$ ranks with the same `seed` and `streamnum=0`, which computes $P$ identical trajectories ($0\times$ variance reduction while inter-rank std falsely reports $0.000$!), and (2) naive cycle splitting of short-period LCGs. SPRNG solves both via parameterized independent streams (`init_sprng(rank, nprocs, global_seed, param)`), dynamic `spawn_sprng` for branching walkers, and `pack_sprng`/`unpack_sprng` for exact restarts.

code_exercises.title: Pearson Chi-Squared Uniformity Test on [0, 1)
code_exercises.prompt_markdown:
Implement `pearson_chi_square_uniformity_test(u_samples, n_bins)` to bin $N$ samples $u_i \in [0, 1)$ into $K = \text{n\_bins}$ equal-width intervals $[k/K, (k+1)/K)$ ($k = 0, \dots, K-1$) and return the 4-tuple `(counts, chi2_stat, dof, reduced_chi2)`:
- `counts`: 1D integer NumPy array of length $K$ summing to $N$,
- `chi2_stat`: Pearson statistic $\chi^2 = \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} \frac{(O_k - E_k)^2}{E_k}$ with $E_k = N/K$,
- `dof`: degrees of freedom $\nu = K - 1$ (`int`),
- `reduced_chi2`: $\chi^2 / \nu$ (`float`).

CHI_SQUARE_CONTRACT_OR_DOF_GAP.diagnostic_rationale: Total sample conservation sum(O_k) = N removes one fluctuation mode, fixing degrees of freedom at dof = K - 1 rather than K.

CHI_SQUARE_DENOMINATOR_OR_DOF_K_MINUS_1_.diagnostic_rationale: Pearson's chi-squared divides each squared residual (O_k - E_k)^2 by the theoretical expected count E_k = N/K, never by the observed count O_k.
